sloka: किम् नु कुःखमLईकम् वा मयि रामे च पश्यसि ।न कथम्चि दृते रामाद्भरतो राज्यमावसेत् ॥२-१२-६१॥
transliteration: kim nu kuḥkhamaLīkam vā mayi rāme ca paśyasi ।na kathamci dṛte rāmādbharato rājyamāvaset ॥2-12-61॥

translations.english: Depriving Rama, Bharata in no way will occupy the kingdom because in the matter of righteousness I think he is superior even to Rama.
